families.theme: Northern pike and living reed ambush blinds: a solitary long-jawed hunter grows broad reed-blade fins that fold flush to hide its outline, then snap open to funnel water into a short lunging burst. Its vegetation is integral living fin anatomy, not worn reeds.
evolution_design: Single-stage long, slim NORTHERN PIKE with a broad flat duckbill-like snout, two large white eyes and a few broad pale side bars. Two large attached reed-leaf pectoral fins and a tall broad tapered reed dorsal fold over its body to form a living ambush blind; they are rooted in normal fin positions and open into strong sharp leaf silhouettes. Long narrow body, strong forked leaf-tip tail, cunning alert face. No limbs, props, leaf clothing, crown or tiny thorns.
families.habitat: Vegetated quiet lake margins and slow river backwaters.
